prompts.background: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the approved gameplay layout EDIT TARGET. Make its clean static background layer for a 320x240 landscape pixel-art game (same 4:3 aspect ratio). Preserve camera, goal position and scale, sky, lights, spectator band, perspective grass and field lines. Remove BOTH players and ALL balls completely; reconstruct grass and net behind them. Remove ALL HUD lettering, the entire power meter, all five result squares and all three target brackets/triangle; replace their top and bottom HUD areas with flat dark green #0B211F. Keep the scene between exactly the same panel boundaries. Change ALL advertising panels below the crowd, including white blocks, white football emblems, red and blue panels, into a continuous plain deep forest-green strip #123C2F. Keep the white goalposts, a simplified sparse net, thin necessary pitch lines and the original sky. No new objects, no people, no ball, no targets, no words, no decorative symbols. Simplify tiny crowd detail for native 320x240 readability; keep crisp chunky pixels, the existing bright retro palette and stable geometry. Do NOT rotate or crop. This is the background layer only, not a gameplay screenshot.
prompts.striker: Transparent pixel-art sheet of the existing anonymous red player from behind, five consistent full-body phases: ready, weight shift, backswing, contact and follow-through; fixed root/baseline, no ball, field, text or shadow.
prompts.blueStriker: Transparent 3x3 pixel-art sheet of one anonymous blue AI shooter from behind. Include ready, contact and follow-through plus six truthful preparatory foot/hip/body cues for top-left, top-center, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-center and bottom-right; consistent scale and root, no ball, field, text, logo or shadow.
prompts.keeperExtra: Transparent one-row pixel-art sheet completing the existing black player-controlled goalkeeper with high-center, low-left and low-right save poses; retain cream gloves, black/dark-charcoal kit, scale and outline style; no ball, field, text or shadow.
prompts.keeper: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: genuine transparent PNG sprite sheet, exactly FOUR equally sized square cells in a 2x2 grid, with NO visible grid lines or labels. Image 1 is ONLY style and character reference. Recreate the anonymous black-haired blue-shirt blue-shorts goalkeeper from the reference, facing the camera. Same cream gloves, dark blue socks, black boots, tan skin, chunky dark outlines and crisp retro pixel art in all frames, same anatomical scale. Top-left: ready stance, slightly crouching with hands out. Top-right: diving horizontally toward SCREEN LEFT, both hands extended left, face forward, legs trailing right. Bottom-left: diving horizontally toward SCREEN RIGHT, both hands extended right, legs trailing left. Bottom-right: low centered crouch with both gloved hands together near the ground to collect a low ball, but do NOT draw a ball. Full body contained within each cell, generous transparent padding, no overlaps. Diving poses naturally wider and shorter than standing but same body scale; do not stretch bodies to fill cells. Suitable for a roughly 28x36 logical pixel standing sprite and roughly 52x28 diving sprite. TRUE transparent alpha outside characters; no painted checkerboard, no black/white background, no shadows, no pitch, no goal, no ball, no text, no logo. Output square, e.g.1024x1024. Production character artwork, not a screenshot.
prompts.ball: Use case: background-extraction. Image 1 is the reference and extraction target: its SINGLE foreground black-and-cream soccer ball, not the advertising icons. Recreate that ball alone as a clean coarse pixel-art game sprite, centered in a square transparent PNG. Same cream white panels, dark navy black patches and chunky stepped circular outline. Keep the sphere front view simple so it is legible at 16x16 pixels. Ball fills about 80 percent of the square with generous transparent margin. Only the ball: no shadow, ground, player, field, text, border, motion lines, diagram or logo. GENUINE alpha transparency outside the ball, not painted checkerboard. Crisp hard pixel edges and flat colors, no fine texture, glow, fuzzy antialiasing or photorealism. It will be displayed at several small sizes by the game. Source artwork, not a screenshot.
